column1: Purpose: See the whole year at a glance, what it costs you to generate a call booked, a call shown, and a completed qualified call.
1. Every number here pulls automatically from the Paid Ads and Expense tabs, there's nothing to enter on this tab.
2. Total Acquisition Spend is Ad Spend plus Other Expenses, that's what you're actually paying to generate calls.
3. Cost Per Call Booked, Cost Per Call Shown, and Cost Per Qualified Call all divide Total Acquisition Spend by that stage's call count.
4. The Total row at the bottom rolls up the full year.
